core: p53 regulation in the DNA damage response
qualifier: p53 stability, phosphorylation and DNA damage checkpoint control
name: p53 stabilization and activity after DNA damage
rationale: Members cover p53 degradation, phosphorylation and target transcription plus gamma-radiation response, G2 damage checkpoint and Cdc25A/CDK inhibition; unlike the confusables they centre on p53 control rather than G2/M mitotic progression, G1/S RB-E2F or APC/C cell-cycle machinery.

qualifier: GPVI collagen receptor cascade and LDL sensitization
name: Platelet activation and aggregation via GPVI collagen receptor
rationale: All members concern platelet activation or its regulation of aggregation; the GPVI cascade and LDL sensitization separate it from confusables built on GPIb-IX-V/VWF adhesion or on ADP, thrombin and thromboxane GPCR signaling.

core: UV lesion repair and replicative DNA synthesis
qualifier: nucleotide excision repair and translesion polymerase bypass
name: UV lesion excision repair, translesion bypass and replicative DNA synthesis
rationale: Members are GG- and TC-NER steps, translesion synthesis by POLH/POLI/POLK/REV1 and polymerase switching/primer synthesis in replication; confusables instead hold base excision, mismatch, alkylation and telomere C-strand pathways.

core: Removal or editing of modified nucleic acid bases
qualifier: direct demethylation/alkylation reversal and APOBEC cytidine deamination with antiviral restriction
name: Nucleic acid base demethylation and APOBEC cytidine deamination
rationale: Members are TET/ALKBH/MGMT demethylation and alkylation reversal plus APOBEC C-to-U editing used in viral restriction; this separates it from excision repair, B-cell somatic hypermutation and ADAR adenosine-to-inosine editing confusables.

qualifier: break-induced replication, recombination intermediate resolution and intra-S checkpoint
name: Replication-coupled break repair and intra-S checkpoint signaling
rationale: Members combine DNA unwinding, polymerase stimulation, break-induced replication, resolution of mitotic recombination intermediates and intra-S checkpoint signaling; confusables focus on telomere maintenance, strand-invasion homologous recombination or general replication.

qualifier: Golgi organization, COPI and endosome-Golgi retrograde and lysosomal sorting routes
name: Golgi structure and Golgi-centred vesicle traffic
rationale: Members cover Golgi assembly/disassembly and ribbon formation, COPI and Golgi-ER retrograde traffic, endosome-to-Golgi and Golgi-to-lysosome transport; confusables instead hold endocytic recycling to the plasma membrane and ARF/RAB GAP signaling.

qualifier: glucokinase control and glycogenolysis
name: Glycogen turnover regulation and glucokinase control
rationale: Members are glucokinase regulation (GKRP, MODY2) and regulation of glycogen synthesis and breakdown; confusables cover glycogen storage diseases, insulin receptor signaling, glucagon/PKA and G6PC phosphate transport.

qualifier: mating, aggression, parental, grooming and exploratory behaviour
name: Mating, social and exploratory behaviour
rationale: Members are mating, insemination, aggression, parental, grooming and locomotory/exploratory behaviours with amygdala development and relaxin receptors; confusables add vocal or observational learning, pheromone response, ethanol and drinking behaviour or sensory perception.

qualifier: neural plate/tube dorsoventral patterning, notochord and spinal neuron specification
name: Neural tube patterning, axial mesoderm and spinal neuron fate
rationale: Members cover neural plate regionalization, dorsoventral neural tube and hindbrain patterning, notochord/floor plate and spinal motor/interneuron fate; confusables centre on somitogenesis, Hox clusters, limb and craniofacial morphogenesis or convergent extension.

qualifier: BMAL1-CLOCK activation and CRY-PER repression loop
name: Core circadian clock BMAL1-CLOCK and CRY-PER feedback loop
rationale: Members are the transcription-translation feedback loop steps (BMAL1/CLOCK phosphorylation and activation, CRY/PER repression and degradation) plus clock entrainment; confusables are clock outputs to metabolism, nuclear receptors or MECP2/NPAS4 neuronal transcription.

qualifier: APP processing, fibril formation and amyloid-beta clearance
name: Amyloid-beta production, fibrillization and clearance
rationale: Members regulate APP synthesis/catabolism, amyloid-beta formation, fibril assembly and clearance, with microglial activation and tangle assembly; confusables are glial activation, proliferation and synaptic plasticity terms lacking amyloid handling.

qualifier: FGFR, EGFR/ERBB2 and PDGFRA mutants, amplifications and membrane fusions
name: Signaling by oncogenic FGFR, ERBB and PDGFRA receptor variants
rationale: All members are constitutive signaling by cancer-associated RTK variants; the FGFR, EGFR/ERBB2 and PDGFRA mutants distinguish it from confusables dominated by ALK inhibitor resistance, ERBB2 drug resistance and cytosolic PDGFR/FGFR/FLT3 fusions.

qualifier: M-CSF (CSF1) receptor signaling
name: M-CSF signaling, osteoclastogenesis and bone resorption
rationale: Members are CSF1/M-CSF and related interleukin receptor signaling with osteoclast differentiation, fusion, proliferation and bone resorption; confusables cover monocyte/macrophage/dendritic differentiation, DAP12 and CSF production.

qualifier: dopamine synthesis and regulation of transmitter uptake and release
name: Catecholamine synthesis and presynaptic transmitter release regulation
rationale: Members are dopamine/catecholamine synthesis, transmitter uptake and secretion control, spontaneous transmission and neuron maturation; confusables are synaptic vesicle recycling, synapse organization or dopamine transport and receptor signaling without synthesis.

qualifier: extracellular ATP export, hydrolysis and P2Y/adenosine receptors
name: Purinergic ATP and adenosine receptor signaling
rationale: Most members concern extracellular ATP release, NTPDase hydrolysis, P2Y and P1 adenosine receptors, with linked amine/NO and agmatine metabolism; confusables are histamine/prostanoid GPCRs, KATP channels, lysophospholipid receptors or calcium entry.

qualifier: positive regulation via transcription of death genes
name: p53 transcriptional induction of apoptosis genes
rationale: Members are p53 transcription of caspases, death receptors and cytochrome-c release genes plus positive regulation of p53-mediated intrinsic apoptosis; confusables hold the negative regulation, BH3-only mitochondrial steps or p53 G1 arrest and expression control.

qualifier: radiation response, apoptosis regulation, checkpoint and senescence
name: p53 DNA damage signaling after radiation: apoptosis and senescence
rationale: Members are positive and negative regulation of p53-mediated apoptosis and damage signaling, X-ray/gamma/UV responses, G2 checkpoint, replicative senescence and lifespan; confusables are p53 transcriptional target sets, p53 degradation/ARF or cell-cycle progression.

qualifier: ERBB2-driven PTK6 activation and downstream AKT/STAT3
name: PTK6 kinase signaling downstream of ERBB2
rationale: Nine of twelve members are PTK6 expression, activation and effector pathways, joined by ERBB2:ERBB3 downregulation, AKT activation and estrogen membrane signaling; confusables are MET, ALK/LTK, generic ERBB adaptor or EGFR downregulation pathways.

qualifier: ryanodine-sensitive release and store-operated calcium entry
name: Store calcium release and store-operated entry regulation
rationale: Members regulate release of sequestered Ca2+ (ryanodine receptor, caffeine, skeletal muscle), ER Ca2+ levels and store-operated entry; confusables emphasise Ca2+ extrusion via Na/Ca exchangers and cardiac contraction.

core: Glutamate-family and aspartate amino acid metabolism
qualifier: glutamine, proline and arginine catabolism with ammonium handling
name: Glutamate-family and aspartate amino acid metabolism, ammonium handling
rationale: Members are glutamate, glutamine, proline, arginine and aspartate/asparagine metabolism with ammonium homeostasis and nitrogen utilization; confusables centre on urea cycle disorders, ornithine/lysine transport or glyoxylate and 2-oxoglutarate metabolism.

core: Smooth muscle contractility in blood pressure control
qualifier: contraction-promoting endothelin and vasoconstriction signals
name: Smooth muscle contractility and vasoconstrictive blood pressure control
rationale: Members are smooth muscle contraction/relaxation regulation, vasoconstriction, endothelin and pulmonary pressure, with damped guanylyl cyclase signaling; confusables are NO-cGMP vasodilation and eNOS activation pathways.

qualifier: fructose bisphosphate control and lactate fermentation
name: Glycolytic flux regulation via fructose bisphosphates and lactate fermentation
rationale: Members concern glycolysis regulation by fructose-2,6- and 1,6-bisphosphate, lactate fermentation, pentose-phosphate and nucleotide catabolism control; confusables are hexokinase-level glucose catabolism, HIF hypoxia and FOXO/mTORC1/p53 metabolic regulation.

qualifier: collagen and elastic fibre synthesis, crosslinking and MMP degradation
name: Collagen and elastic fibre synthesis, assembly and MMP degradation
rationale: Members cover collagen biosynthesis, fibril organization and crosslinking, elastic fibre assembly and MMP-driven collagen/elastin degradation; confusables are generic ECM expression modules or aortic development and fibrinogen terms.

qualifier: JAK-STAT transduction and its regulation
name: Growth hormone receptor JAK-STAT signaling and its regulation
rationale: All three members are growth hormone receptor signaling and its regulation via JAK-STAT; confusables are other JAK-STAT cytokines (IL-2/7/9, IL-6 family), leptin or insulin receptor signaling.

qualifier: p53 death-gene transcription and PUMA/NOXA BH3-only activation
name: p53 death-gene transcription and PUMA/NOXA mitochondrial apoptosis
rationale: Members are p53 transcription of apoptotic genes plus PUMA/NOXA activation, BH3-only inhibition of BCL-2 and cytochrome c release; confusables cover BAX/BAK/BAD/BID activation and apoptosome steps or GO p53 regulation terms.
